title: SAFARI: Versatile and Efficient Evaluations for Robustness of Interpretability
reasoning: The paper mentions 'trustworthy AI' and 'responsible AI' as high-level goals that Explainable AI (XAI) can contribute to. However, the core focus of the paper's methodology and experiments is on evaluating the technical robustness of interpretation methods against input perturbations and developing new metrics and algorithms for this purpose. It does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
